targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  'Polygon Records' as metric,
  COUNT(*) as value
FROM intg_one_minute_live_polygon
WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Tiingo Records' as metric,
  COUNT(*) as value  
FROM intg_one_minute_live_tiingo
WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Avg Quality Score' as metric,
  ROUND(AVG(quality_score), 3) as value
FROM (
  SELECT quality_score FROM intg_one_minute_live_polygon WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  UNION ALL  
  SELECT quality_score FROM intg_one_minute_live_tiingo WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
) combined
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Avg Latency (ms)' as metric,
  ROUND(AVG(data_latency_ms)) as value
FROM (
  SELECT data_latency_ms FROM intg_one_minute_live_polygon WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT data_latency_ms FROM intg_one_minute_live_tiingo WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' 
) combined
